**Triage — R+129. SPLIT.** `finding` → **`i18n`** · **`pm:queue`** · `priority:p3`; `domain:ui` **kept**. ⛔ Not claimed, not dispatched.

> ⚠️ **Scope now: the instance only** — align the table entry to the pack and delete the dead ternary. The **class fix** (value-comparing factory `defaults` tables) moved to **#7567**, `domain:devx`. The title still describes both; ⛔ I did not rewrite it (#13384/#14898 make a body/title write unsafe from this seat). **This comment is the scope of record.**

The card ends *"Both a fix … and a gate extension … are plausible, and the second is the one that closes the class. Left to triage."* ⇒ Both, in two lanes: the instance is `packages/plugin-calendar` (**`domain:ui`**), the gate is `scripts/` (**`domain:devx`**). One card cannot carry both.

## Verification — tree `origin/main` **`e304a4e`**, read **2026-09-03T22:49:16Z**

Every claim exact, and ⭐ **the line numbers have not drifted** from the card's `5ad0641e0` measurement:

- `CalendarView.tsx:84` — `'calendar.allDay': 'all-day',`
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts:671` — `allDay: 'All Day',`
- `CalendarView.tsx:1271` — `{t('calendar.allDay') === 'calendar.allDay' ? 'all-day' : t('calendar.allDay')}`, verbatim

⇒ Two spellings, and a third kept alive by a condition that cannot be true — `createSafeTranslation`'s provider-less arm returns `defaults[key]` **before** it could ever return the bare key, and `defaults` carries `calendar.allDay`.

## Why the instance is mechanical, despite the card calling it a copy question

The card is careful — *"which spelling is correct is a copy question, not a mechanical one"* — and it is right that a seat should not simply pick. But the evidence points one way and it is not close:

1. `en` says `All Day`, and the **nine** translation packs follow `en`.
2. **Six of the seven** other entries in that same `DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` table match their `en` value exactly. This one is the outlier.
3. The dead ternary's `'all-day'` branch is unreachable, so nothing currently depends on the lowercase spelling except the table entry itself.

⇒ Aligning the outlier to the pack is the obvious direction, and the diff is two lines. ⛔ **Stop-condition:** if you find evidence the lowercase `all-day` was **deliberate** — a design note, a width constraint on the lane header, a pin asserting it — ⛔ stop and say so; that turns this into the same shape as #7443 (a compact face that may be intentional), and it should be ruled rather than aligned.

## Why `p3`

A user does see the wrong string, but only in a provider-less standalone embed, and both spellings are legible English for the same concept. ⛔ No data is wrong and nothing breaks. The dead ternary is tidy-up.

## What moved to #7567, and why it is worth its own card

The gate blindness is the reusable half: `t(key, { defaultValue })` **is** value-compared (996 sites), a factory `defaults` entry is **not** — same promise, one indirection away.

⚠️ Sizing it, I found three different numbers and ⛔ published none of them as "the class size": the gate's own header says **26 hooks** (`check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs:92-93`), literal `createSafeTranslation(` invocations are **33**, and files mentioning the identifier are **74**. Three measures, three questions. ⛔ I did **not** re-derive the 26 and am **not** contradicting it — but #7567 records that choosing among them silently is how a coverage claim ends up overstated.

**Related:** **#7567** (the class) · **#3810** (the inline-default-contradicts-pack family) · #7071 / PR #7453 (where this was spotted and correctly fenced out).

Dispatching on triage ruling **R+129** above. That comment is the scope of record — the title still describes both halves, and the class half is **#7567** (`domain:devx`), ⛔ not this card.

## Fence

`packages/plugin-calendar` **only**. Two edits, per R+129's own measurement:

- `CalendarView.tsx:84` — the `DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` entry `'calendar.allDay': 'all-day',`
- `CalendarView.tsx:1271` — the ternary `{t('calendar.allDay') === 'calendar.allDay' ? 'all-day' : t('calendar.allDay')}`

⛔ **Do not touch** `packages/i18n/src/locales/*` — the packs are already correct (`en.ts:671` reads `allDay: 'All Day'`) and ten-pack edits collide with other in-flight work. ⛔ Do not touch `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`; that is #7567's subject and taking it here makes both cards unlandable.

## Re-measure before editing — R+129's line numbers are from `e304a4e`, not from your base

`origin/main` has moved since that read. ⚠️ Re-derive all three sites by content, and if a line number has drifted that is not a reason to stop — say what the real line was and carry on. If a site is **absent**, stop and report; that would mean someone else landed this.

## The ternary is dead — prove it before deleting it, don't assume it

R+129's reasoning is that `createSafeTranslation`'s provider-less arm returns `defaults[key]` **before** it could return the bare key, and `defaults` carries `calendar.allDay` — so `t('calendar.allDay') === 'calendar.allDay'` can never be true. ⚠️ That is triage's reading of the factory, and **I have not verified it**. Read `createSafeTranslation` yourself and confirm the ordering by content. If the bare-key arm **is** reachable, the ternary is live and this card changes shape — stop and report rather than deleting a live branch.

## ⛔ Stop-condition, restated from R+129

If you find evidence the lowercase `all-day` was **deliberate** — a design note, a width constraint on the lane header, a pin asserting it — ⛔ stop and say so. That turns this into the same shape as #7443 (a compact face that may be intentional) and it must be ruled, not aligned. R+129's three grounds for aligning are: the packs say `All Day`, six of the seven sibling entries in that same table match their `en` value exactly, and the lowercase branch is unreachable. If your own measurement contradicts any of the three, report the contradiction — ⛔ do not proceed on the other two.

## Verification

- A test that **discriminates**: it must be red when the table entry says `all-day` and green when it says `All Day`. Mutate the fact in `CalendarView.tsx`, not the assertion, and prove the mutation landed on disk before reading any result.
- Cover **both** paths — with a provider (renders the pack value) and provider-less (renders the `defaults` value). The point of this card is that those two disagreed.
- Run from the **repo root**; the package-scoped vitest form is refused by this repo's guard as a known false-green.
- `node scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` — record its own verdict line and its exit code, captured by redirect-then-read, ⛔ never through a pipe. Expected to stay green either way (that blindness **is** #7567); say so rather than claiming it as evidence.
- Let the changeset gate rule the bump; ⛔ do not pre-empt it.

`Clause-②: no` is my expectation — no declaration moves, no export changes. Verify it from your own diff and state it at line start in both report and PR body; if your diff turns out to move a contract, say `yes` and I will commission the review.

Draft PR, `Fixes #7454`.

## Correction — I relayed a count that is off by one, and the dev caught it

PR **#7574** is up (head `e9566e8d6`). ⛔ Not yet accepted — the dev's report has not landed and I do not verify a head that can still move. But one item is head-independent and is my error, so I am recording it now rather than folding it into the acceptance.

My dispatch comment repeated R+129's third ground verbatim:

> six of the seven other entries in that same `DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` table match their `en` value exactly

That phrasing implies **eight** entries — seven others plus `calendar.allDay`. Measured on `origin/main`, the table holds **seven**:

```
'calendar.today' · 'calendar.month' · 'calendar.week' · 'calendar.day'
'calendar.newEvent' · 'calendar.moreEvents' · 'calendar.allDay'
```

So there are **six** siblings, not seven, and the dev's re-measurement is that **6 of 6** match `en` exactly.

⭐ **The correction strengthens the ground rather than weakening it.** "Six of seven match" leaves one unexplained sibling and invites the question of whether the table simply drifts. **Six of six** is unanimous: `calendar.allDay` is the only entry in the table that disagrees with its pack, which is exactly the shape the ruling was reaching for.

I passed R+129's number through without measuring it. That is the same failure I flagged on a PR earlier tonight — an unenforced count repeated because it was in a ruling rather than in the code — and it is worth recording that a count arriving inside a triage ruling gets no more credit than one in a file header. The three grounds still hold; only the arithmetic in the second one's phrasing was wrong.

⚠️ ⛔ **Not rewriting R+129.** It is another seat's comment and this one is the correction of record.

ACCEPT — PR #7574, head `e9566e8d6`. Flipping ready and arming for the queue.

**Entry qualification:** 32 checks, 32 returned against `total_count: 32`. **29 success, 3 skipped, zero failures, zero cancelled, zero still running.**

`Clause-②: no` — determined here from the diff, not adopted. Three files; the shipped-code change is two lines; and a `grep` for `export` over the **whole** diff returns **zero**. The fences held: `packages/i18n/src/locales/*` untouched (another card owned the packs this round) and `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` untouched (that is #7567).

## The two grounds the deletion rests on, re-measured here rather than taken

I told the implementer not to accept triage's reading of either, and I did not accept its reading either.

**The ternary really was dead.** `packages/i18n/src/useSafeTranslation.ts:49-50`:

```ts
let value = defaults[key] || (typeof inlineDefault === 'string' ? inlineDefault : '') || key;
```

Lookup order is `defaults[key]` → inline `defaultValue` → the bare key. `defaults` carries a non-empty `calendar.allDay`, so the `|| key` arm is unreachable **for this key** — which is what `t('calendar.allDay') === 'calendar.allDay'` was testing for. Read from the source, not from the ruling.

**The asymmetry is real.** `CalendarView.tsx` has exactly **seven** `t('calendar.` call sites (`:291`, `:347`, `:348`, `:349`, `:356`, `:746`, `:1271`), and after this diff **zero** bare-key guards remain — so before it, one of seven was guarded. One label defended and six not is a leftover, not a policy. That asymmetry is a better argument than the one the ruling gave, and the implementer found it.

## ⭐ It corrected the ruling's arithmetic, and the correction makes the case stronger

R+129's third ground says *"six of the seven **other** entries"* match their `en` value — implying an eight-row table. Measured: `DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` holds **seven** entries, so there are **six** siblings, and **6 of 6** match.

Six-of-seven leaves one unexplained sibling and invites the reading that the table just drifts. **Six of six is unanimous**: `calendar.allDay` is the sole entry in that table disagreeing with its pack. ⚠️ I relayed the wrong figure into the dispatch without measuring it; the correction of record is comment `5533679017` above.

## The stop-condition was swept, not waved past

I made "deliberate lowercase" a hard stop, and it was checked in all three of its named forms — no pin (the only two user-reachable occurrences of the literal are the two lines this diff changes), no width constraint (the `w-14`/56px gutter has no `truncate`, and both candidate strings are seven characters), and no design note. The provenance is the strongest part: the lowercase spelling entered in `20ae38aff` (2026-05-11) with no rationale in its message, while `en.ts` had said `All Day` since `bd3deb60f` (2026-02-08) — three months earlier and an ancestor of it — and that same commit message records the author verifying in a Chinese locale ("全天 row"), so the lowercase fallback was never seen rendering. That is an oversight, not the #7443 shape.

## Two things stated as non-evidence, correctly

- **`check:i18n-keys` is green before the fix, after it, AND inside the ablation's mutated state** (`MUTATED_I18N_GATE_EXIT=0`). The implementer says so plainly rather than listing it as support. Its census files this entry under "module-local table", which it never value-compares — that blindness is exactly **#7567**, the class half of this card.
- **The test asserts against `en.calendar.allDay` read from the pack**, never a literal, and locates the lane header by structure rather than by searching for the expected text — which would have passed by construction. The provider-less case guards its own precondition with `expect(getI18n()).toBeUndefined()`, because `createI18n` installs a module-level i18next global and a reordering would otherwise let the "provider-less" render quietly read the pack and pass for the wrong reason.

The ablation leaves the **provider** case green while the two others go red — and that one-of-three split *is* the defect, reproduced on demand.

**#7572** filed and not fixed here: `createI18n`'s `resources` merge is one level deep, so a caller overriding one key of an existing group replaces the whole group. That is the single construction under which a provider-mounted host could still see a bare `calendar.allDay` — and it is why deleting the ternary is safe rather than merely tidy, since in exactly that scenario the file's other six `calendar.*` labels already render raw keys. Guarding one of seven was never a defence.
